build_feature_module: build a FeatureModule to extract CPC features from audio batches with optional collapsing
build_model_phone_combined: build a ModelPhoneCombined to concatenate CPC feature extraction with phone prediction
load_model_from_checkpoints: load a CPCModel from checkpoint files with optional state dict loading
build_features_from_audio: build features from an audio file using a FeatureModule with chunking and normalization
load_supervised_criterion: load a supervised phone criterion from a checkpoint path with CTC or standard mode
